Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 July. The fix was that IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for Vantorre's billing department. Gideon's message that morning in this channel is the source for this.

One thing to check: a 30 Sep digest describes #8841 differently, as Mateo's report that drivers couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, escalated to platform engineering. The 1 July message doesn't mention that problem, so the two may not be the same issue. Gideon can confirm.
